description: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight (Foundation fork: HDR10/HDR Vivid, virtual displays, desktop control panel).
notes: This package uses the upstream portable ZIP; upstream recommends the installer for normal use, portable is meant for special cases such as running several instances.
Settings, app list and pairing data live in $dir\config (persisted across updates).
Installing the service, the virtual display driver or the gamepad driver needs an elevated prompt; see the scripts folder.
Web manager: https://localhost:47990/ (desktop control panel: start Sunshine from the Start menu).
